text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 약점: 총자산이익률(ROA) 3.4%.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Weakness: Return on assets 3.4%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: 3-yr EPS growth (annual) 50.0%.

text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 강점: 총자산 중 무형자산·영업권 비중 1.6%. 약점: 부채비율(총부채/자기자본) 자본잠식.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Intangibles and goodwill share of assets 1.6%. Weakness: Liabilities to equity negative equity.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Free cash flow yield 8.7%. Weakness: Price to book n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리). 부채가 많은 편이라 금리 영향이 더 커요.
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts). Higher debt makes it more rate-sensitive.
